content: I understand your Power Widget Pro has stopped working. I can offer you a replacement — would that work for you?

A replacement is obviously the long-term solution, but that doesn't help me with my presentation in two hours. Do you have a software bypass or a temporary configuration workaround I can use to get this unit functional *today*? 

Also, how exactly do you plan to expedite that replacement, and when will it arrive? I don't have time for a standard 3-5 day shipping window.
